name: Birdsville Track
reason: Wikivoyage and tourism board name this famous outback route; a drive visitors do.

name: Coober Pedy
reason: Town with underground dugouts and opal mines, guide headline (Wikivoyage, tourism board).

name: Coober Pedy Golf Club
reason: Wikivoyage Stuart Highway names the grassless desert course as a thing to do, but one source, a club venue; quirky icon, arguable.

name: Glendambo
reason: Roadhouse/motel stop; Wikivoyage names nothing to see or do.

name: Innamincka
reason: Wikivoyage: Cooper Creek township, with Dig Tree and waterholes nearby; a destination in the outback.

name: Kanku-Breakaways Conservation Park
reason: Parks SA page and Wikivoyage name the Breakaways landscape 33 km from Coober Pedy.

name: Kingoonya
reason: Tiny hamlet with a pub; nothing named to see or do except access to another place.

name: Lake Eyre scenic flights from William Creek
reason: Operator/scenic flight; the place is Kati Thanda-Lake Eyre.

name: Lyndhurst
reason: Wikivoyage lists it only as the Strzelecki Track start and a fuel stop; nothing distinct to see in the cited sources.

name: Marree
reason: Wikivoyage article and tourism board: rail town at the start of the Birdsville and Oodnadatta Tracks, heritage hotel.

name: Marree Lake Eyre scenic flights
reason: Operator/scenic flight; the place is Kati Thanda-Lake Eyre.

name: Marree Man
reason: Wikivoyage names it a sight worth seeing, but only by charter flight; no ground visit, one view-from-air experience.

name: Oodnadatta
reason: Wikivoyage and tourism board: Oodnadatta Track town with the Pink Roadhouse landmark; a base for visitors.

name: Pimba
reason: Roadhouse hamlet; nothing to see beyond fuel and a meal.

name: Roxby Downs
reason: Mining town with visitor centre; sources name no attraction to see (Olympic Dam tours are an operator).

name: Woomera
reason: Wikivoyage: Missile Park, Rocket History Museum and heritage centre, open to the public.
